title: Safety Plus
description: safetyplussrv.com Safety Plus is a Canadian trucking safety and compliance consulting company founded in 2012 and based in Brampton, Ontario, the country's transport hub. Led by owner and safety officer DP Singh, it has served over 250 trucking companies across North America with a small team of about five specialists. It is a one stop shop for cross border carriers, handling US and Canada certifications like C-TPAT, CSA customs self assessment, PIP and EPA SmartWay. It also secures authorities and permits including CVOR, IFTA fuel tax filing, IRP plates and New York, Kentucky and Oregon weight distance taxes. Certified DOT specimen collectors and breath alcohol technicians run fast drug and alcohol testing, results often in ten minutes without appointment. Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 230 reviews, drivers praise its friendly staff and quick service. Open Monday to Friday plus Saturday mornings at 40 Maritime Ontario Boulevard, Brampton.
